baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction assigns the reply specifically to the settlement's mutrafun, while their speech uses the collective first person.
baseline_models.mechanism: A warning enters a gathered polity, but the class released by abundance occupies the speaking position and turns its factional refusal into the settlement's public answer.

activation_trace.role: The gathered-people image makes the qaryah a social container within which one class can claim the public voice.
The literal emergence of speech marks refusal as a public act rather than an unspoken private state.
Abundance that lets its possessor act unchecked supplies the social power of the answering elite.
The truth-blocking image gives the elite declaration its function as a gate against the warning.

changed_reading.before: A settlement collectively rejects a warner.
changed_reading.after: A prosperity-enabled speaker class voices and socially installs a collective refusal inside a gathered polity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mutrafuha and kafirun place luxuriant enablement directly beside covering or denying.
baseline_models.mechanism: The very abundance that enables the elite also becomes what their response conceals: dependence on a giver and exposure to warning. Disbelief therefore carries an ingratitude mechanism, not only a proposition denied.

activation_trace.role: The warning image supplies a danger meant to awaken caution within conditions of ease.
The branch's expansive luxury supplies both the elite's privilege and the material whose contingency is suppressed.
Covering a blessing turns the declaration into refusal to acknowledge abundance as gift.

changed_reading.before: The affluent happen to be disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Affluence is part of the refusal mechanism: enjoyed gift becomes a cover against the warning that could expose its dependence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Arsalna and ursiltum bracket the ayah, while qala introduces a counter-utterance about the carried content.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah traces a communication relay from sender through warner into a settlement, followed by an elite counter-message that publicly severs the recipients from what was carried.

activation_trace.role: Messenger, message, and carried speech make both sendings the endpoints of one communicative relay.
Danger-notice gives the relayed content its intended effect of awakening caution.
Audible speech supplies the return transmission that opposes the incoming message.
Disavowal and detachment make kafirun a declared severance from the message, not mere failure to receive it.

changed_reading.before: A messenger arrives and is not believed.
changed_reading.after: A completed delivery is intercepted by a local counter-transmission that declares corporate detachment from its content.

context_deltas.mechanism: Saba supplies a material analogue for the focus pattern: a provisioned settlement is asked for gratitude, turns away, receives another kind of sending, has its gardens substituted, and its connected villages end as torn fragments. The warning rejected by prosperous concentration now reads as the last intelligible intervention before abundance and gathering reverse into loss and dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Unchecked abundance anchors the contextual prosperity-and-reversal sequence back in the focus elite.
Recognition of blessing names the response that the prosperous settlement was materially equipped to make.
Dispatch or release links the focus sending to the later release of the flood without making the two objects identical.
The flowing-flood image supplies the material force that reverses settled abundance.
One thing standing in place of another makes the changed gardens a legible exchange of conditions.
Covering blessing explicitly connects material reversal to ingratitude and sharpens the same focus root.
Gathered settlements extend qaryah from one civic container into a secure connected network.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the terminal opposite of the focus settlement's gathering.

structural_cues: 34:15-19 moves in order from good land and commanded gratitude to turning away, destructive sending, substituted yield, kufr, linked villages, requested distance, and fragmentation.
The same focus roots r-s-l, k-f-r, and q-r-y recur inside that sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratitude, a flood sent, substitution, kufr, linked villages, and tearing apart; I supply the arrow from rejected warning to a gathering-to-dispersal reversal. A live alternative is that Saba is a close analogy rather than the causal template for every settlement.

changed_reading.before: Prosperous elites reject a verbal warning.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal sits at the hinge where gathered abundance can reverse: one sending is verbally covered, and the Saba sequence shows another sending undoing the settlement's material and social containment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dispute between the made-weak and the self-exalting disassembles the focus plural 'we.' Speech is passed back and forth until the dependent side identifies elite command and diversion as the machinery that produced its kufr; the later collars materialize the binding effect of that social command.

activation_trace.role: Unchecked privilege anchors the later self-exalting command structure in the focus speaker class.
Speech exchanged over an affair turns the single focus declaration into a later contest over who authored it.
Returning words and answers supplies the forensic reversal in which the old consensus is reopened.
Lack of strength marks the dependent constituency hidden inside the elite's collective first person.
Rank and leadership identify the elevated side whose speech can organize public refusal.
Turning and diverting names the disputed causal action between elite speech and others' loss of guidance.
Command as an obligating demand supplies the coercive arrow from elite plotting to collective kufr.
Truth-blocking occurs both as the commanded act and as the final identity, exposing a reproduced social outcome.
The collar that binds an organ materializes the dependence and constraint previously carried through speech.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 repeatedly alternates speech between the made-weak and the self-exalting before naming command to disbelieve.
34:34 immediately generalizes from that dialogue to what affluent speakers say whenever a warner enters a settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal parties, returned speech, disputed diversion, commands to disbelieve, and collars; I infer that the focus 'we' is manufactured consensus voiced from above. The live alternative is voluntary following under influence rather than direct coercion in every case.

changed_reading.before: The affluent merely report their community's shared disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Their 'we' is a political speech act: the privileged voice helps manufacture the consensus it claims to report, while dependent voices become audible only when the declaration is reopened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The elite explain their refusal by treating superior wealth and offspring as evidence of immunity. The following contrasts separate expanded provision from rank or nearness, then replace closed possession with expenditure and replenishment. Mutraf status thus generates a false inference from quantity to security, while the corrective model makes wealth a circulating trust.

activation_trace.role: Luxury that releases its holder supplies the focus condition later verbalized as wealth-based confidence.
Covering blessing lets accumulated provision function as a screen against its giver.
Competitive outnumbering makes abundance a comparative status claim rather than a neutral possession.
Acquiring and multiplying property supplies the first alleged proof of exemption.
Descendants supply continuity and social multiplication as the second alleged proof of exemption.
Expansion and increase recast abundance as distributed provision, not a verdict of favor.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the reversible opposite of expansion.
Nearness explicitly names the relation that wealth and offspring cannot produce.
Proximity as rank distinguishes genuine standing from mere material scale.
Wealth leaving in expenditure supplies the open circulation opposed to elite enclosure.
A successor replacing what went out makes relinquishment compatible with renewed provision.

structural_cues: 34:35 states the affluent rationale immediately after the focus formula: more wealth and children, therefore no punishment.
34:36-39 repeatedly separate provision's expansion or restriction from nearness and redirect possession into expenditure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a boast, claimed immunity, reversible provision, denied nearness, expenditure, and replacement; I infer the elite syllogism 'more means approved and safe' and its correction through circulation. Alternatively, the boast may express bravado without a fully articulated theology.

changed_reading.before: Luxury disposes elites toward denial in a general psychological sense.
changed_reading.after: Their denial protects a specific status calculus: accumulated wealth and lineage are misread as proof of approval and immunity, while the surah recodes provision as reversible and meant to circulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus refusal is generated in a gathered settlement by a privileged plural voice. The later admonition changes the scale of reception: subjects rise for God in pairs and singly, then let the heart turn the matter over. The counter-practice to elite consensus is therefore not another mass slogan but temporary decomposition of the crowd into accountable reflective units.

activation_trace.role: The gathered-people image supplies the collective environment from which reflection must be differentiated.
Publicly emitted speech supplies the group declaration opposed by quieter deliberation.
A frightening reminder that softens the heart reconnects the proposed practice to the focus warning.
Separation and singularity introduce a scale smaller than the settlement's collective voice.
Rising with resolve supplies active personal accountability rather than passive social inheritance.
Joining one to one makes the pair a bounded unit for mutual testing.
The solitary individual removes the shelter of the elite-authored plural.
The heart's repeated turning supplies a receptive process opposite to instant categorical refusal.
The renewed danger-warning closes the loop back to the focus nadhir after the crowd has been decomposed.

structural_cues: The focus places a plural declaration inside a gathered qaryah; 34:46 explicitly moves through one admonition, pairs, individuals, reflection, and warning.
The reflective instruction comes after repeated scenes of inherited slogans and unequal group speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered civic speech and a later sequence of pairwise or solitary reflection; I infer that changing social scale interrupts elite consensus. A live alternative is that 34:46 prescribes careful inquiry generally without diagnosing the focus refusal's social production.

changed_reading.before: The warning fails because the recipients hold a settled opinion.
changed_reading.after: The settled opinion is partly a scale effect: collective speech closes inquiry, while the surah's answer is to step out of the crowd, test the claim in pairs or alone, and only then reform a judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus says the message was sent into the settlement and reached its addressees. The closing sequence reverses that accessibility: revelation is near, then opportunity escapes; late believers try to reach from a distant position, their earlier speech is exposed as remote hurling, and a barrier falls between them and desire. Refusal converts delivered nearness into irrecoverable distance.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and arrival anchor the spatial-temporal reversal in a message that genuinely reached the settlement.
Divine disclosure supplies the available guidance carried by the focus sending.
Nearness establishes accessibility before the closing scene shifts to failed reach.
The failure of apprehension or arrival marks the moment when access can no longer be recovered.
The interrogative 'from where or how' frames late belief as an access problem.
Reaching by extension supplies the attempted return toward what was formerly delivered.
Distance names the new relation to the once-near message.
Hurling speech or accusation recasts their earlier counter-message as projection rather than reception.
Prior truth-blocking supplies the action that precedes and explains the later access reversal.
A separating barrier makes the final loss of access spatially explicit.

structural_cues: 34:50 ends with nearness; 34:51 removes escape; 34:52 asks about reaching from far away; 34:53 recalls prior kufr and remote hurling; 34:54 installs a barrier.
The focus's active and passive forms of r-s-l insist that delivery occurred before this reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered sending, nearness, missed access, attempted reach, distance, remote speech, prior kufr, and a barrier; I supply the temporal arrow by which refusal turns access into distance. Alternatively, the final scene can remain an eschatological consequence without adding a temporal nuance to r-s-l itself.

changed_reading.before: The elites reject content that has been delivered to them.
changed_reading.after: Their rejection spends a finite interval of nearness: the message reaches them now, but their remote counter-speech helps produce a later state in which they can no longer reach back to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: When clear signs are recited, refusal expands into a reusable counter-script: discredit the man, invoke ancestral practice, label the message fabrication or magic, and ignore the absence of inherited books or prior local warning. Earlier peoples with far greater resources used the same denial. The focus qala is therefore the compressed speech event through which privilege translates evidence into familiar dismissive labels.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people anchors the later labels as a repeatable public script.
Attributing what is not so supplies the repeated acts of attaching dismissive identities to messenger and message.
Diversion makes the accusation against the messenger a defense of inherited worship.
A lie turned away from truth supplies one ready-made label for neutralizing the recited signs.
Invented falsehood intensifies the counter-script from refusal to an account of fabricated origin.
Diversion and deception supply another label that reverses clear evidence into manipulation.
Written letters and text mark the documentary authority that the ancestral defense lacks.
Following a book through reading or study sharpens the stated absence of an evidentiary tradition.
The lack of an earlier local messenger makes the inherited counter-script socially old but not messenger-authorized.
Absence of a prior danger-warning exposes the novelty of their claimed traditional warrant.
Contradiction of truth repeats the same response among predecessors and makes the script transhistorical.
A tenth part measures the current elites against predecessors with much greater material capacity, without improving receptivity.

structural_cues: 34:43 repeats qala three times as the labels move from man, to fabrication, to magic.
34:44 denies supporting books and a prior local warner; 34:45 immediately compares the speakers with more heavily provisioned predecessors who denied messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated labels, ancestral defense, absent books, absent prior warning, and stronger predecessors; I infer a socially reusable elite counter-script that substitutes classification for engagement. A live alternative is that these are several groups' spontaneous objections rather than one coordinated repertoire.

changed_reading.before: The focus quotation is a generic statement of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: It compresses a repertoire of status-preserving speech: classify the messenger and message, appeal to inherited practice, and let circulating labels replace evidentiary reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping rather than the ordinary semantics of qala. It remains anchored at the focus speech root and is echoed by explicit q-l-l occurrences around gratitude and reduced yield. Downstream prose should present it only as a sound/root activation in which elite speech makes the warning socially 'little,' not as a translation of qala.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qala at word 8 is packet-mapped not only to q-w-l but also to q-l-l, whose branch image is littleness.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping's littleness image lets the elite utterance function imaginatively as diminution of the warning.
Explicit scarcity marks grateful servants as socially few and gives the diminution activation a nearby ethical scope.
The little surviving yield turns social minimization into a material image after prosperous refusal.

changed_reading.before: The elites' saying only reports their disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their public saying also performs diminution: it makes the warning count for little, amid a surah where gratitude is little and rejected abundance is reduced to little.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the vow branch of n-dh-r through the noun nadhir and reads a declarative plural as oath-like self-binding. It remains anchored in the focus warning, public saying, and disavowal, with later command and collars supplying a visible binding mechanism. Downstream prose should call it an anti-vow analogy, not claim that nadhir lexically means vow here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The nadhir occasions an immediate public 'inna...kafirun,' which can be carried as a corporate counter-commitment.

activation_trace.role: Self-imposed obligation supplies the exploratory vow image triggered by the focus nadhir.
Overt speech gives the imagined counter-vow a public performative form.
Disavowal supplies the content of the corporate commitment: declared severance from what was sent.
Obligating command shows how a public rejection can be socially imposed and maintained.
The binding collar supplies a later material image for the constraint generated by the counter-commitment.

changed_reading.before: The warning receives a negative answer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the warning provokes an anti-vow: elite speech binds a corporate identity around disavowal, and the social bond later appears as literal restraint.

strongest_changes: The focus plural is not transparent consensus; 34:31-33 reveals privileged speech, command, and dependent followers as its production mechanism.
Saba turns elite ingratitude into a gathering-to-dispersal reversal in which a rejected sending is followed by a materially destructive sending.
34:35-39 identifies the elite inference from wealth and children to immunity, then separates provision from nearness and recodes wealth as circulation.
34:50-54 turns successful delivery into a temporal access problem: what arrived near can no longer be reached after sustained refusal.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus formula operate simultaneously as a social gate, a material reversal, a status calculus, and a time-limited communication event. The split q-l-l mapping and the n-dh-r obligation branch also preserved two contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The ayah does not by itself decide whether the affluent truly represent the whole settlement or merely perform that representation.
The Saba sequence may be an especially close analogy rather than a causal template for every qaryah in the focus generalization.
The q-l-l diminution and n-dh-r counter-vow readings depend on deliberately exploratory branch activation and should not bear ordinary lexical claims.
